sentences.reason: Kidney and salt results share the same hydration guidance and referral advice.
sentences.sentence: Drink water regularly through the day, more in hot weather or after sweating. Good hydration helps your kidneys and keeps results reliable.

sentences.reason: Kidney and salt results share the same hydration guidance and referral advice.
sentences.sentence: Talk to a doctor if kidney results are abnormal, especially with diabetes, high blood pressure, swelling, foamy urine or passing much less urine.

sentences.reason: Liver enzyme results share liver-support guidance.
sentences.sentence: Keep alcohol low or avoid it. Your liver has to break down every drink, and alcohol is a common cause of liver strain.

sentences.reason: Liver enzyme results share liver-support guidance.
sentences.sentence: Cut back on sugary drinks, sweets and fried foods. Extra sugar and fat can build up in the liver.

sentences.reason: Liver enzyme results share liver-support guidance.
sentences.sentence: Stay active and work towards a healthy waist size. Losing even a little extra weight can reduce fat in the liver.

sentences.reason: Liver enzyme results share liver-support guidance.
sentences.sentence: Do not start herbal or bodybuilding supplements without advice. Some can harm the liver.

sentences.reason: Blood sugar results share the same guidance and referral advice.
sentences.sentence: Fill half your plate with vegetables and pair rice or roti with dal, curd, paneer, eggs or other protein. This slows how quickly sugar enters your blood.

sentences.reason: Blood sugar results share the same guidance and referral advice.
sentences.sentence: Swap sugary drinks, sweets and refined flour for water, whole fruit and whole grains like millets or brown rice. These cause smaller sugar spikes.

sentences.reason: Blood sugar results share the same guidance and referral advice.
sentences.sentence: Take a 10 to 15 minute walk after main meals. Physical activity helps your body manage blood sugar, and sugar after a walk is often lower than before.

sentences.reason: Blood sugar results share the same guidance and referral advice.
sentences.sentence: Aim for enough sleep. A healthy weight, regular activity and enough sleep are part of the lifestyle that may help prevent insulin resistance.

sentences.reason: Blood sugar results share the same guidance and referral advice.
sentences.sentence: Talk to a doctor if your blood sugar results are above range, so they can check for prediabetes or diabetes. Both are common and often have no symptoms.

sentences.reason: Blood sugar results share the same guidance and referral advice.
sentences.sentence: Seek care promptly if you have extreme thirst, passing a lot of urine, unexplained weight loss, blurred vision, or feel shaky, sweaty or confused from low sugar.

sentences.reason: Iron results share iron guidance.
sentences.sentence: Include iron-rich foods such as dal, chana, rajma, green leafy vegetables, jaggery in moderation, eggs, fish or meat. Your body needs iron to make haemoglobin.

sentences.reason: Iron results share iron guidance.
sentences.sentence: Have a vitamin C food with iron-rich meals, such as lemon, amla, guava or tomato. Vitamin C helps you absorb iron from plant foods.

sentences.reason: Iron results share iron guidance.
sentences.sentence: Keep tea and coffee away from meals by about an hour. They reduce how much iron you absorb.

sentences.reason: Iron results share iron guidance.
sentences.sentence: Talk to a doctor if iron results are low, so they can find the cause, such as heavy periods or blood loss from the gut, before starting tablets.

sentences.reason: Iron results share iron guidance.
sentences.sentence: Talk to a doctor if iron results are high, as iron overload can harm the liver and heart.
